items.headline: Google is bringing a more personal version of its Gemini AI assistant to your car
items.detail: Google is bringing Gemini's Personal Intelligence feature to cars, allowing its AI assistant to draw on information from Gmail, Calendar, Maps, YouTube, and other Google services to deliver more personalized responses while driving.

items.headline: GM to close Detroit battery assembly plant, but not for reasons you might think
items.detail: GM is shuttering the Brownstown Battery Assembly Plant, though the closure has nothing to do with the automaker's electrification strategy.

items.headline: TikTok has started censoring searches for popular peptides
items.detail: Trying to pull up information for certain peptides on TikTok is now returning a "no results found" page when searching for terms like semaglutide, BPC-157, retratutide, and others.
